help: the reviewer's one act (issues/483) - refuses what cannot merge, relocates once onto a moved base, runs the data gate on the head, flips the body's phrasing to closes, squashes pinned to that head, and converges this checkout; each step beneath

explanation.refuses: anything not OPEN, a checkout that holds the head with a dirty tree - refused before any read but the one that named the head, the dirt left where a red gate wrote it (issues/975) - a body whose aim lines are not in the aim's one grammar - one issue per line, as corpus-yoga forge raise writes them (issues/884) - or has none, a title that copies no aimed issue's title (issues/479), an aimed issue whose open blocker the body does not aim to complete (issues/482), or refuse-class drift in the standing report
explanation.relocates: once onto the base, only if it moved - in a detached worktree of its own under tmp/forge/merge/, disposed of whatever happens, so this checkout never moves for it (issues/507); the lifetime's one rebase, replaying only the commits the base does not already hold, tree for tree (issues/585); rsc/test/ conflicts are the syntactic class, taken wholesale and settled by the gate's own regeneration; any other conflict aborts back to review
explanation.resyncs: a clean checkout that holds the branch, and says so
explanation.gates: runs the data gate - corpus-yoga pipeline run, which opens on the commit gate (issues/541, issues/549) - at the head being merged, in a detached worktree of its own under tmp/forge/merge, the head's code over this checkout's corpus reached by link (issues/937), so that this checkout stands where it stood until the fast-forward; the worktree is disposed of whatever the gate says, and a red halts as the last word, naming the gate, the failing stage(s) and the head (issues/601)
explanation.flips: the body's phrasing to closes, as the LAST edit before the squash; a refused squash restores the body as found, so a flipped-but-unmerged PR cannot exist; a squash whose reply is lost is read back from the forge first, and a PR the forge holds merged is concluded as merged (issues/931)
explanation.verifies: that the forge's closing references of the flipped body are the aimed set, read back from the forge (issues/884); where they differ the body is restored and nothing merges, so what the flip rewrote and what the squash closes cannot differ on main
explanation.squashes: pinned to the head every check saw, with no message flags, so the body is assembled from the branch's commits and keeps their signatures
explanation.converges: this checkout on the merge commit
explanation.concludes: the merge as a fresh process of the tree converged on (issues/910) - the sweep via corpus-yoga forge clean, each aimed issue's state, the effect - so that a merge that changes an interface those steps call cannot break them
explanation.ends: with each aimed issue's state read from the forge after the squash (issues/735), now:, and one anchored verdict - DONE naming the squash and how many aimed issues the forge closed, or NOT DONE naming the halt, each headed forge merge

args.name: pr
args.help: the PR to merge, as a number, a URL or a branch

does: reads the PR's state, base and head before anything else, its body for the phrase to flip, and its title for the copy check
reads the merge commit after the squash, and a merged PR's final head for the relocation
reads the PR that introduced a base commit, for the relocation point
reads the PR's closing references back after the flip, refusing where they are not the aimed set (issues/884)
reads both refs to judge whether the base moved
reads the squash back so the base can fast-forward
reads the head's sha on the forge, the lease the relocation's push is held to
WRITES the relocated head back to the PR, leased against the sha the merge read - only when the base had moved
WRITES the flipped body as the last edit before the squash, every aims-to-complete line becoming a closes line - and WRITES it back as found if the squash is refused
WRITES the merge, pinned to the merge's own sha of the head every check saw - fetched or just pushed, never re-read from the eventually-consistent API
WRITES the deletion of the server branches this merge and its siblings left, through forge clean's sweep
